items.title: Anterior deltoid pain
items.snippet: Front of the shoulder and down the front of the upper arm, close to the muscle itself. Often blamed on the joint.

items.title: Lateral deltoid pain
items.snippet: Outside of the shoulder cap and the side of the upper arm toward the deltoid's insertion.
kw: Outside of the shoulder or upper arm

items.title: Posterior deltoid pain
items.snippet: Back of the shoulder and the back of the upper arm.
kw: Infraspinatus or teres minor trigger points

items.title: Teres major pain
items.snippet: Back of the shoulder and the back of the upper arm, sometimes the back of the forearm. Hurts reaching up and forward.

items.title: Pectoralis major upper head pain
items.snippet: Front of the shoulder over the front delt, often mistaken for a front-shoulder joint problem.

items.title: Pectoralis major lower head pain
items.snippet: Front of the chest, down the inner arm to the inner elbow and the ring and little fingers. Chest pain must be checked by a doctor first.
kw: Heart pain (angina): must be ruled out first

items.title: Subclavius pain
items.snippet: Under the collarbone and down the front of the arm and forearm into the thumb, index and middle fingers.

items.title: Coracobrachialis pain
items.snippet: Front of the shoulder, the back of the upper arm and forearm, and the back of the hand toward the middle finger.
kw: Back of the hand or wrist

items.title: Biceps long head pain
items.snippet: Front of the shoulder over the biceps groove and down the front of the arm toward the elbow crease.

items.title: Biceps short head pain
items.snippet: Front of the shoulder near the collarbone tip, the inner front of the arm and the elbow crease.

items.title: Triceps long head pain
items.snippet: Back of the shoulder and arm, up toward the base of the neck, and down the back of the forearm.
kw: Teres major or minor trigger points

items.title: Triceps lateral head pain
items.snippet: Back of the upper arm and the outside of the elbow, a common tennis-elbow look-alike, and the back of the forearm.

items.title: Triceps medial head pain
items.snippet: The point of the elbow and the inner elbow, a golfer's-elbow look-alike, sometimes the ring and little fingers.

items.title: Middle trapezius pain
items.snippet: Burning ache between the shoulder blade and the spine, and the top of the shoulder.
kw: Inner edge of the shoulder blade

items.title: Lower trapezius pain

items.title: Rhomboid minor pain
items.snippet: Along the inner edge of the upper shoulder blade, next to the spine.
kw: Inner edge of the shoulder blade

items.title: Rhomboid major pain
items.snippet: Between the shoulder blade and the spine. Often strained because tight chest muscles pull the blades apart.

items.title: Wrist extensors pain
items.snippet: Outside of the elbow (tennis elbow) and the back of the wrist and hand on the thumb side.
kw: Back of the hand or wrist

items.title: Finger extensors pain
items.snippet: Back of the forearm and back of the hand into the middle or ring finger; a 'stiff fingers' feeling.
kw: Back of the hand or wrist
Radial tunnel / posterior interosseous nerve irritation

items.title: Wrist flexors pain
items.snippet: Inside of the elbow (golfer's elbow) and the palm side of the wrist.
kw: Palm side of the wrist and hand

items.title: Finger flexors pain
items.snippet: Palm and the front of the fingers, sometimes a 'trigger finger' catching feeling.
kw: Palm side of the wrist and hand

items.title: Iliocostalis pain
items.snippet: Low back and buttock from the lumbar part; the lower shoulder blade and even the belly from the thoracic part.
kw: Flank or side of the low back
Bottom tip of the shoulder blade
Upper buttock at the belt line

items.title: Longissimus pain
items.snippet: Low in the buttock and over the SI joint, often well below where the muscle actually is.
kw: SI joint and back of the pelvis

items.title: Adductor longus & brevis pain
items.snippet: Deep groin, the inner thigh and down to the inner knee and top of the shin.

items.title: Adductor magnus pain
items.snippet: Deep inside the pelvis and groin, and the inner thigh from the groin toward the knee.

items.title: Biceps femoris pain
items.snippet: Back of the knee on the outside and up the back of the thigh.

items.title: Semitendinosus & semimembranosus pain
items.snippet: The buttock crease, back of the thigh and the inner back of the knee, sometimes the inner calf.

items.title: Vastus intermedius pain
items.snippet: Front of the mid-thigh, worse climbing stairs or standing up from a chair.

items.title: Suboccipitals pain
items.snippet: A band of headache from the base of the skull wrapping to behind the eye and the forehead. Often mistaken for migraine.

items.title: Occipitalis pain
items.snippet: Ache at the back of the head that can shoot through the skull to behind the eye, with scalp tenderness.

items.title: Upper trapezius pain
items.snippet: Up the side of the neck, behind the ear and into the temple (a question-mark shape). Very common tension headache source.
kw: Where the neck meets the shoulder

items.title: Sternocleidomastoid pain
items.snippet: Forehead, around and behind the eye, cheek, ear and top of the head. Can cause dizziness or ear fullness.

items.title: Levator scapulae pain
items.snippet: The angle where the neck meets the shoulder, down the inner edge of the shoulder blade. Classic "stiff neck, can't turn my head".
kw: Where the neck meets the shoulder
Inner edge of the shoulder blade
Upper trapezius pain (often co-exists, but referral is different)

items.title: Scalenes pain
items.snippet: Chest, front and back of the upper arm, inner shoulder blade and down the forearm to the thumb and index finger. Can add tingling in the hand.
kw: Where the neck meets the shoulder
Back of the hand or wrist
Outside of the shoulder or upper arm
Inner edge of the shoulder blade
Cervical disc herniation (pinched nerve in the neck).

items.title: Splenius capitis & cervicis pain
items.snippet: Pain on the top of the head, and deep ache inside the head behind the eye.
kw: Cervicogenic headache (headache originating from the neck joints).

items.title: Temporalis pain
items.snippet: Temple headache, above the eyebrow and into the upper teeth.

items.title: Masseter pain
items.snippet: Jaw, cheek, in front of the ear and the back teeth. Can feel like an earache or toothache.

items.title: Supraspinatus pain
items.snippet: Deep ache at the top and side of the shoulder that can run down the outside of the arm to the elbow. Worse reaching overhead.
kw: Outside of the shoulder or upper arm
Subacromial bursitis (often occurs alongside supraspinatus issues).
Cervical radiculopathy (a pinched nerve in the neck referring pain to the shoulder).

items.title: Infraspinatus pain
items.snippet: Deep in the front of the shoulder joint, down the front and outside of the arm. Hard to reach behind your back or sleep on that side.
kw: Outside of the shoulder or upper arm
Cervical radiculopathy (pinched nerve in the neck)

items.title: Teres minor pain
items.snippet: A localized deep ache at the back of the shoulder.

items.title: Subscapularis pain
items.snippet: Back of the shoulder, down the back of the arm, sometimes a band around the wrist. Can feel like a frozen shoulder.
kw: Back of the hand or wrist
Long head of biceps tendon pathology

items.title: Pectoralis minor pain
items.snippet: Front of the shoulder and chest, down the inner arm to the last three fingers. Can pinch nerves to the hand.
kw: Palm side of the wrist and hand
Thoracic outlet syndrome (Pec Minor is a common cause of this)

items.title: Serratus anterior pain
items.snippet: Side of the rib cage and the bottom tip of the shoulder blade; a side "stitch" that hurts with deep breaths.
kw: Bottom tip of the shoulder blade

items.title: Latissimus dorsi pain
items.snippet: Bottom tip of the shoulder blade and down the back of the arm to the ring and little fingers.
kw: Bottom tip of the shoulder blade
Palm side of the wrist and hand
Cervical radiculopathy (pinched nerve in the neck)

items.title: Intercostals pain
items.snippet: Sharp or aching pain along the rib, worse with deep breaths, coughing or twisting.
kw: Belly or side of the abdomen

items.title: Brachioradialis pain
items.snippet: Outside of the elbow and the web of the thumb.

items.title: Supinator pain
items.snippet: Outer elbow and the thumb web; common in tennis elbow that won't settle.
kw: C6 or C7 cervical radiculopathy (pinched nerve in the neck)

items.title: Quadratus lumborum pain
items.snippet: Low back and flank, over the SI joint and buttock, and the point of the hip. Hurts rolling in bed, standing up or coughing.
kw: Flank or side of the low back
SI joint and back of the pelvis
Upper buttock at the belt line
Kidney pain or kidney stone (check for fever, nausea, or changes in urination)

items.title: Multifidus pain
items.snippet: Deep, pinpoint pain right next to the spine, the sacrum and sometimes the tailbone.
kw: SI joint and back of the pelvis
Lumbar facet joint syndrome (very closely related and often co-existing)

items.title: Psoas pain
items.snippet: Vertical band along the low back, plus the front of the thigh and groin. Hard to stand up straight after sitting.
kw: Belly or side of the abdomen
Hip joint arthritis or labral tear

items.title: Iliacus pain
items.snippet: Groin, front of the thigh, and the back of the pelvis high in the glute. Often overlooked.
kw: Upper buttock at the belt line
SI joint and back of the pelvis
Hip joint impingement (FAI) or labral tear

items.title: Gluteus medius pain
items.snippet: Along the belt line, over the SI joint, the buttock and the top of the hip.
kw: Upper buttock at the belt line
SI joint and back of the pelvis

items.title: Gluteus minimus pain
items.snippet: Outer hip down the side of the thigh and leg to the ankle, or down the back of the thigh and calf. A common sciatica look-alike.
kw: Lumbar radiculopathy (true sciatica from a disc herniation)

items.title: Piriformis pain
items.snippet: Mid-buttock and back of the hip, down the back-outside of the thigh toward the calf.
kw: Lumbar radiculopathy (true sciatica from a disc herniation)

items.title: Gluteus maximus pain
items.snippet: Buttock and the tailbone; aches with long sitting and walking uphill.
kw: Sciatica or lumbar radiculopathy (nerve root irritation).

items.title: Tensor fasciae latae pain
items.snippet: Front-outer hip down the outside of the thigh, usually stopping at the knee.
kw: IT band syndrome (though TFL is often the root cause).
Hip labral tear or femoroacetabular impingement (FAI).

items.title: Rectus femoris pain
items.snippet: A deep ache around and behind the kneecap, and the front of the hip bone. Worse on stairs or after sitting.

items.title: Vastus medialis pain
items.snippet: Inner knee and inside of the kneecap; can make the knee feel like it buckles.

items.title: Vastus lateralis pain
items.snippet: Down the outer thigh to the outside of the knee; can make lying on that side painful.

items.title: Popliteus pain
items.snippet: Back of the knee; worse crouching, walking downhill or running.
kw: Posterior horn of the meniscus tear
Baker's cyst (a fluid-filled sac behind the knee)

items.title: Gastrocnemius pain
items.snippet: Upper calf, back of the knee and the arch of the foot; deep cramp-like tightness.
kw: Soleus muscle strain (pain is typically lower in the calf)
Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) - a blood clot (this is a medical emergency)

items.title: Soleus pain
items.snippet: Heel and Achilles tendon, lower calf; can contribute to plantar fasciitis.
kw: Heel spur or stress fracture of the calcaneus

items.title: Tibialis posterior pain
items.snippet: Inner ankle and arch, along the inner shin; common with flat feet.

items.title: Tibialis anterior pain
items.snippet: Front of the shin, front of the ankle and the big toe.
kw: Front of the ankle or big toe

items.title: Peroneals pain
items.snippet: Outer ankle and outside of the foot; common after ankle sprains.
kw: Fracture of the 5th metatarsal (base of the little toe)

items.title: Foot muscles pain
items.snippet: Heel and sole of the foot; first-step-in-the-morning pain like plantar fasciitis.
kw: Plantar fasciitis (these two conditions are very closely related and often occur together)
Heel pad atrophy (thinning of the fat pad under the heel)

items.title: Medial pterygoid pain
items.snippet: Back of the mouth and throat, under the jaw, in front of the ear and deep inside the ear. Can make swallowing uncomfortable.

items.title: Lateral pterygoid pain
items.snippet: Deep in the jaw joint just in front of the ear, and up into the cheek and sinus area. The most common muscular source of true TMJ pain.
kw: Temporomandibular joint internal derangement, where the disc itself is displaced.
Dental problems in the upper molars.

items.title: Digastric pain
items.snippet: Under the chin and into the floor of the mouth, the front lower teeth, and behind the angle of the jaw toward the ear.
kw: Dental problems in the lower incisors.
Salivary gland inflammation or a stone.
Swollen lymph nodes under the jaw.

items.title: Semispinalis capitis pain
items.snippet: A band of pain wrapping from the base of the skull over the head toward the forehead and temple; often described as a tight hat band.
kw: Occipital neuralgia, where the greater occipital nerve itself is irritated.
Cervicogenic headache arising from the upper neck joints.

items.title: Longus colli pain
items.snippet: Deep front of the neck and throat, sometimes a sore-throat feeling or discomfort swallowing. Weakness here shows up as aching elsewhere in the neck.

items.title: Platysma pain
items.snippet: A prickling or burning across the front of the neck and upper chest, and sometimes over the jawline and chin.
kw: Nerve irritation in the neck causing skin sensations.

items.title: Frontalis pain
items.snippet: Forehead pain spreading up from the eyebrow on the same side, and a sense of pressure above the eyes.
kw: Sinus inflammation of the frontal sinus.

items.title: Rectus abdominis pain
items.snippet: A band across the low back at belt level from the upper part, and a band across the lower abdomen from the lower part. Can feel like period pain or in
kw: Belly or side of the abdomen
Abdominal organ problems, which must be excluded first.
Hernia at the midline or through a surgical scar.

items.title: Internal oblique pain
items.snippet: Groin and lower abdomen, and across the front of the hip; can produce a deep groin ache mistaken for a hernia or hip problem.
kw: Belly or side of the abdomen
Inguinal hernia, which must be excluded.
Hip joint problems including labral tear.

items.title: Transversus abdominis pain
items.snippet: A band across the low back and the lower abdomen. Weakness here shows up as low back pain rather than pain in the muscle itself.
kw: Belly or side of the abdomen

items.title: Serratus posterior superior pain
items.snippet: Deep ache underneath the shoulder blade that you cannot reach, spreading down the back of the arm to the little finger side.
kw: Inner edge of the shoulder blade
Rib joint irritation at the upper back.
Cervical disc problems referring into the shoulder blade.

items.title: Serratus posterior inferior pain
items.snippet: A nagging ache across the lower ribs at the back, just above the waist, that is often mistaken for kidney or low back pain.
kw: Flank or side of the low back
Kidney infection or stones, which must be excluded.
Quadratus lumborum or thoracolumbar back pain.

items.title: Spinalis pain
items.snippet: A narrow strip of pain close to the spine in the mid and upper back, between and just below the shoulder blades.
kw: Thoracic facet or rib joint irritation.
Vertebral compression fracture, particularly in older adults.
Referred pain from the chest or abdomen.

items.title: Brachialis pain
items.snippet: Base of the thumb and the web of the thumb, and the front of the elbow. A frequently missed cause of thumb pain.
kw: De Quervain's tenosynovitis at the thumb side of the wrist.

items.title: Pronator teres pain
items.snippet: Deep in the front of the forearm toward the wrist and the base of the thumb; can add tingling in the thumb, index and middle fingers.
kw: Carpal tunnel syndrome, which usually wakes people at night.
Golfer's elbow at the inner elbow.

items.title: Anconeus pain
items.snippet: A small, well-localised area of pain over the outer point of the elbow, close to the muscle itself.
kw: Tennis elbow, which sits slightly forward of this.
Olecranon bursitis, which produces visible swelling.

items.title: Thumb abductors pain
items.snippet: The thumb side of the wrist and along the back of the thumb; pain gripping, pinching and turning the wrist.
kw: Back of the hand or wrist
De Quervain's tenosynovitis, which involves the same tendons at the wrist.
Thumb base arthritis, which is lower, at the joint itself.

items.title: Adductor pollicis pain
items.snippet: The web and base of the thumb and across the thumb side of the palm; pain with pinching and writing.
kw: Palm side of the wrist and hand
Thumb base arthritis, which is at the joint rather than in the web.
Ulnar nerve problems at the elbow or wrist.

items.title: Thenar muscles pain
items.snippet: The thumb pad and the palm side of the thumb, and sometimes into the wrist; weakness here affects every grip.
kw: Palm side of the wrist and hand
Cervical radiculopathy affecting the C6 nerve root.

items.title: Hypothenar muscles pain
items.snippet: The little finger side of the palm and the little finger itself; often sore after leaning on the heel of the hand.
kw: Cubital tunnel syndrome at the elbow.
Ulnar nerve compression at the wrist.
Cervical radiculopathy at the C8 nerve root.

items.title: Sartorius pain
items.snippet: A sharp or tingling line down the front of the thigh along the muscle itself, and into the inner knee.
kw: Meralgia paresthetica, where the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve is compressed.
Hip flexor strain involving psoas or rectus femoris.
Hip joint problems including labral tear.

items.title: Pectineus pain
items.snippet: Deep in the groin just below the crease, and into the upper inner thigh. A common missed cause of a groin that will not settle.
kw: Inguinal hernia, which must be excluded.
Hip joint problems including labral tear and osteoarthritis.

items.title: Gracilis pain
items.snippet: A hot, superficial, stinging line down the inner thigh, sometimes continuing to the inner knee.
kw: Pes anserine bursitis at the inner knee.

items.title: Quadratus femoris pain
items.snippet: Deep in the buttock low down near the sit bone, and into the back of the hip; hurts to sit on.
kw: Piriformis syndrome, which sits higher in the buttock.
Proximal hamstring tendinopathy, which is directly on the sit bone.

items.title: Obturator internus pain
items.snippet: Deep in the buttock and the back of the hip, sometimes into the back of the thigh. Pain is often felt deeper than any muscle you can press.
kw: Hip joint problems including labral tear.

items.title: Semitendinosus pain
items.snippet: The buttock crease and the back of the thigh, into the inner back of the knee and sometimes the upper inner calf.

items.title: Semimembranosus pain
items.snippet: The buttock crease and the back of the thigh, concentrating deep in the inner back of the knee.
kw: Baker's cyst at the back of the knee.

items.title: Abductor hallucis pain
items.snippet: The inner heel and along the inner border of the foot; a frequent companion to plantar heel pain.
kw: Tarsal tunnel syndrome, where the nerve is compressed near this muscle.

items.title: Flexor hallucis longus pain
items.snippet: The ball of the foot under the big toe, and along the inner ankle behind the bone; the dancer's tendon.
kw: Tibialis posterior tendinopathy, which runs in a neighbouring groove.

items.title: Flexor digitorum longus pain
items.snippet: The sole of the foot along the line of the smaller toes, and the inner ankle; often cramps at night.

items.title: Extensor hallucis longus pain
items.snippet: The top of the foot along the line of the big toe, and the front of the ankle.
kw: Front of the ankle or big toe
Extensor tendinopathy across the top of the foot.
Anterior tarsal tunnel syndrome, which compresses the deep fibular nerve.

items.title: Extensor digitorum longus pain
items.snippet: The top of the foot across the smaller toes, and the front of the ankle and outer shin.
kw: Front of the ankle or big toe

items.title: Plantaris pain
items.snippet: The back of the knee and the upper inner calf; a sudden sharp pain here is sometimes called tennis leg.
kw: Medial gastrocnemius tear, which is more common and presents similarly.
Deep vein thrombosis, which must be excluded.
Baker's cyst, which can rupture and cause calf pain.
